nemotron.name: Nemotron Streaming ASR
nemotron.description: A stateful streaming speech engine on Apple Silicon. Audio is processed incrementally while attention and convolution caches carry context between chunks.
nemotron.detail: The implementation retains reference paths and includes tests comparing encoder frames and decoder tokens. A benchmark harness measures processing time and memory; a macOS dictation app connects the engine to microphone input and text insertion.
ai: Implemented a stateful, cache-aware streaming pipeline for NVIDIA's Nemotron ASR model on Apple Silicon, with bounded audio history and incremental encoder/decoder state.
Added frame/token equivalence tests against the reference implementation, configurable lookahead, a latency benchmark harness, and a macOS dictation app.
swe: Separated audio buffering, encoder/decoder state, session lifecycle, and dictation integration into independently testable Python modules.
Implemented bounded audio history, session reset/tail flushing, and reference-equivalence tests for streaming correctness.

rag.name: PDF RAG API
rag.description: A PDF question-answering service that combines semantic and keyword search, reranks retrieved passages, and streams answers with source references.
rag.detail: Dense search and BM25 results are merged with reciprocal rank fusion before BGE cross-encoder reranking. The API includes SHA-256 deduplication, asynchronous ingestion, task status, document deletion, and stage latency metrics. CI is configured for unit tests and a Qdrant integration service.
ai: Built hybrid retrieval using dense embeddings, BM25, reciprocal rank fusion, and BGE cross-encoder reranking behind a FastAPI question-answering service.
Implemented asynchronous PDF ingestion, content-hash deduplication, and SSE answer streaming with source references and stage latency metrics.
swe: Built FastAPI endpoints for asynchronous PDF ingestion, task status, document management, and SSE answer streaming; added SHA-256 content deduplication.
Separated API, service, embedding, and storage layers; configured pytest unit tests, Qdrant integration tests in GitHub Actions, and Docker Compose.

vision.name: pi-mlx-vision
vision.description: A local vision tool for text-only coding agents. A TypeScript extension asks a resident Python vision model to describe an image or answer a focused question.
vision.detail: The extension manages a child inference process over JSON-lines stdio, with request IDs, readiness signaling, request timeouts, and exit handling. The model stays loaded between calls and the tool is disabled when the active agent model already supports vision.
ai: Built a describe_image tool for text-only coding agents using a local MLX vision model and a TypeScript extension.
Kept the model resident in a persistent Python inference server, avoiding repeated model loads; disabled the tool when the active model supports vision.
swe: Built an npm-packaged TypeScript extension that manages a persistent Python child process over a JSON-lines stdio protocol.
Implemented request-ID correlation, readiness signaling, request timeouts, and process-exit handling so inference can be reused across tool calls.
